Chapter 911: Chapter 13: The Seventh Realm Of Space And Time (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 911: Chapter 13: The Seventh Realm of Space and Time (Subscription Requested)

The Emperor of Demonic Beings is very special; his level of power far surpasses that of the top Jade Immortals.

After all, the demonic creatures are but a condensation of a wisp of Demonic Qi from the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

And the Emperor of Demonic Beings is the ultimate form born from the endless sea of demonic creatures.

It’s not an exaggeration to say that he is an incarnation of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

Therefore,

In the numerous wars between Immortals and Demons, what the Immortals of the Immortal Realm dread the most is the Emperor of Demonic Beings.

As for the ordinary demonic creatures?

Even in endless numbers, they could not possibly breach the defense formations of the great Immortal Cities.

As long as they endure until the passage to the Demon Abyss dissipates, that will be enough.

Having experienced several wars between Immortals and Demons, Yun Zhenzi is well aware of the terror of the Emperor of Demonic Beings. Even with the help of an Immortal City, a massive war Immortal Artifact,

At best one can only inflict severe injuries, with virtually no hope of achieving a kill.

However, now.

In the eyes of Yun Zhenzi, the power of an entire Immortal City can barely rival the Emperor of Demonic Beings…

Yet he is now struggling desperately between the fingers of Lin Yuan.

“Master…” Yun Zhenzi’s mind seems to be in a muddle.

When he first entered the Spirit World of Lin Yuan, he witnessed that towering figure symbolizing unparalleled spiritual will,

Leaving Yun Zhenzi almost believing that Lin Yuan might be the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, the supreme being.

But Yun Zhenzi soon abandoned this thought, as there are significant differences between the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and Lin Yuan.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path resides high in the Origin of the Immortal Realm, looking down upon all Immortals, obviously not the case for Lin Yuan.

Over the years, Lin Yuan has displayed horrific alchemy skills and means beyond what even top Jade Immortals could match, but there’s still a large gap between him and the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

But now?

Yun Zhenzi is once again plunged into confusion.

Single-handedly capturing a sky full of demonic creatures, among which there are six Emperors of Demonic Beings, who other than the Ancestor of the Immortal Path could perform such a feat?

Jade Immortals?

No matter how many Jade Immortals there are, as long as they dare to leave the Immortal City and lose its protection, they are nothing but delectable food in the eyes of the Emperor of Demonic Beings.

Since the emergence of the Demon Abyss, there has never been a case where a Jade Immortal, relying solely on their own power, has managed to briefly contend with the Emperor of Demonic Beings.

If they cannot even contend, let alone suppress, and here it’s suppressing six at once.

…

“Emperor of Demonic Beings?” Lin Yuan looks at his right palm, his gaze falling on those six Emperors of Demonic Beings.

About to step into the Seventh Realm of Space-Time, almost reaching the threshold of this level, only to be interrupted by these demonic beings, causing Lin Yuan slight impatience.

Therefore, he took direct action.

If saying when Lin Yuan first arrived in the Immortal Realm, he needed to keep a low profile, endure when possible, to avoid attracting the attention of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path or the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss prematurely,

Then now,

With the breakthrough to the Seventh Realm of Space-Time imminent, there is no longer any need to deliberately endure.

Even now, Lin Yuan already possesses some of the characteristics of the Seventh Realm of Space-Time.

For example, suppressing the six Emperors of Demonic Beings with a single palm – such suppression is not about absolute power.

Currently, Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit, aside from the spiritual will, is not necessarily stronger in other aspects than an individual Emperor of Demonic Beings.

Upon advancing to the Second Layer in the Immortal Realm, there is no such thing as being instilled with the Origin Source of the Immortal Realm; therefore, even with the mystical gourd blessing, the world within the Taiyang Divine Spirit is only a few hundred million miles in circumference.

In terms of the physical body… The vast majority of resources obtained in the Immortal Realm are sent as much as possible to the true body, the Origin. The strength of the Taiyang Divine Spirit’s physical body is approximately at the level of a regular Emperor of Demonic Beings.

The endless demonic creatures and the six Emperors of Demonic Beings struggle in vain in the palm of Lin Yuan’s hand, the root cause being the suppression of the Space-Time Domain.

Lin Yuan suppresses all the demonic beings firmly with the Space-Time Rule Domain.

With Lin Yuan’s current understanding of space-time, even if he truly faces the Ancestor of the Immortal Path or the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, he would still manage with ease.

The key point is that, at this moment, the one acting is merely the Taiyang Divine Spirit, which can be completely discarded when necessary.

The true body, the Origin, resides in hidden, unknown places, isolated by the cause and effect of space-time, and even the ultimate beings of the Twelfth Layer, such as the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, would take a tremendous amount of time to locate and lock on to it.

So, at this moment, Lin Yuan, in this Immortal Realm, essentially has nothing left to be cautious or wary of, and once he fully steps into the Seventh Realm of Space-Time, he will be truly unhindered and fearless.

“These Emperors of Demonic Beings…” Lin Yuan examines the six Emperors of Demonic Beings caught between his fingers, and even though he’s suppressing these demonic creatures at a rule level,

Lin Yuan does not underestimate them, for after all, these Emperors of Demonic Beings essentially arose from the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss and are part of this ultimate being of the Twelfth Layer.

“This feeling?”

Lin Yuan frowns, observing the ordinary demonic creatures is still manageable, but these Emperors of Demonic Beings show an aspect utterly opposite to those practicing the Immortal Cultivation System, like the contrast between white and black, life and death.

…

“Where is this?”

“What place is this?”

To Lin Yuan’s scrutiny, the six Emperors of Demonic Beings have no self-awareness, but suddenly finding themselves in a different world, each becomes extremely panicked.

They were born in the Demon Abyss, and apart from the omnipresent Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, they have never experienced such fear.

“Why can’t I feel the Demon Abyss anymore?”

“Right, I can’t feel it either.”

One by one, the Emperors of Demonic Beings’ scalps explode, for to these demonic creatures, the Demon Abyss is far more than just their lair.

It bears the effect of something akin to a source-origin connection.

Any Emperor of Demonic Beings can always sense the presence of the Demon Abyss and can instantly return to the Demon Abyss if they wish.

But now,

The vast, nearly equal to the Immortal Realm Demon Abyss, has disappeared into thin air.

To be precise, it’s not that the Demon Abyss has disappeared, but they can no longer sense the existence of the Demon Abyss.

…

“They are of no use to me at the moment.”

After observing for a moment, Lin Yuan lightly shakes his head and exhales softly.
